name: pi-subagent-durable

scripts.check: rm -rf /tmp/pi-subagent-durable-check && npx esbuild extensions/index.ts extensions/context-inherit.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@earendil-works/* --external:@rmux/* --external:typebox --outdir=/tmp/pi-subagent-durable-check && node tests/identity.test.mjs && node tests/dispatch.test.mjs && node tests/session-resume.test.mjs && node tests/safety.test.mjs && node tests/ownership-registry.test.mjs && node tests/context-inherit.test.mjs
